sources.title: GitHub - HugoS7/llama-text2sql
sources.snippet: Fine-tuning Llama 3.1 8B for Text-to-SQL (QLoRA) Turn a natural-language question plus a database schema into an executable SQL query. Fine-tuned with QLoRA (4-bit NF4 base + LoRA adapters) on a single GPU, and — the part that matters — evaluated with execution accuracy against real SQLite databases rather than by string-matching the output.

sources.title: Easily Finetune Llama 2 for Your Text-to-SQL Applications
sources.snippet: In this tutorial, we show you how you can finetune Llama 2 on a text-to-SQL dataset, and then use it for structured analytics against any SQL database using the capabilities of LlamaIndex.
